Res.Caption: Attach
Res.FullDescription: The attachment type, if Delivery Mode is Email.

Res.Caption: Official
Res.FullDescription: The official contact who will appear within the body of certain documents.

Res.Caption: Direction
Res.FullDescription: Direction for documents - i.e. Import or Export.

Res.Caption: Foreign
Res.FullDescription: Contact will receive documents only if the foreign port on the job matches this value.

Res.Caption: Local
Res.FullDescription: Contact will receive documents only if the local port on the job matches this value.

Res.Caption: Mode
Res.FullDescription: Contact will receive documents only if the shipment mode matches this value.
